contract.variant: Standing two-hand kettlebell pullover, hands on the horns, bell upside down
contract.counting: One arc over the head, lower behind the head and back to the chest
contract.phases: Bell upside down at the chest, hands on the horns beside the handle; carry it up over the head with the elbows bent; lower it behind the head; bring it back over the head to the chest
contract.contacts: Both feet planted; both hands on the horns; elbows bent throughout; ribs down, no low-back arch
